scripts.build: vp run project:generate && xcodebuild -project YiruMobile.xcodeproj -scheme YiruMobile -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:release: vp run project:generate && xcodebuild -project YiruMobile.xcodeproj -scheme YiruMobile -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath build/ReleaseDerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.dev: vp run @yiru/daemon#build && vp run project:generate && node scripts/start-development.mjs
scripts.format: xcrun swift-format format --configuration .swift-format --in-place --recursive YiruMobile YiruWidgets YiruNotificationService Shared/Widgets Shared/Notifications
scripts.lint: xcrun swift-format lint --configuration .swift-format --strict --recursive YiruMobile YiruWidgets YiruNotificationService Shared/Widgets Shared/Notifications
scripts.check: vp run lint && vp run build && vp run build:release
